summary: When a husband loses his job, his wife picks up more work over the next years and covers a large share of what the household lost.
realLife: An NBER study found wives increased their labor supply after a husband's displacement, and in the long run the added work made up more than a quarter of the lost income.
sources: National Bureau of Economic Research working paper w8260, Worker Displacement and the Added Worker Effect: https://www.nber.org/papers/w8260
inGame: spouse tie in a household plus both job records; the spouse's new or longer job is a new-coworker event.

turns.summary: The spouse is already at full hours or ill and cannot take more.
The spouse follows a lead to a firm near home.
turns.writesBack: new job record for spouse; new coworker ties
